answer: Because the orchard stamp is verified against the quartz nonce, the spiral audit can check it and a recycled stamp fails the binding. A farm hence pays the hashing cost per key per epoch, which is a linear compute bill rather than a one-off build. Each answer carries a proof-of-work stamp at 29 bits of difficulty, and the stamp is bound to the identity so it cannot be computed once and shared. A 187 account operation therefore ties up 20 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
